name: generate_plan
description: Generate a structured weekly training plan based on the user's goals, schedule, experience, and any injuries collected during intake. Call this only after all intake questions have been answered.

weeks.description: Total duration of the program in weeks.

days_per_week.description: Number of training days per week.

injuries.description: List of injuries or limitations to work around, e.g. ['lower back pain', 'left knee']. Empty array if none.

schedule.description: One entry per training day. Rest days are omitted — the frontend fills gaps.

session_type.description: e.g. 'Upper Body – Push', 'Lower Body – Pull', 'Full Body', 'Cardio + Core'

id.description: Stable unique ID for this exercise slot, e.g. 'mon_ex_1'. Used by patch operations to target specific exercises without regenerating the full plan.

reps.description: Rep target. Use a string to allow ranges and special cases: '5', '8-12', '30 seconds', 'AMRAP'

rest_seconds.description: Rest between sets in seconds, e.g. 90

load_guidance.description: How to pick the weight, e.g. 'RPE 8', '75% 1RM', 'Bodyweight', 'Light — technique focus'

notes.description: Optional coaching cue or substitution note, e.g. 'Keep chest up out of the hole' or 'Sub: Goblet Squat if no barbell'

progression_note.description: How to progress this exercise week over week, e.g. 'Add 2.5 kg when all sets completed with good form'

deload_week.description: Which week number is the deload week, if applicable. Omit if program is under 6 weeks.

rag_sources.description: List of document chunk IDs from ChromaDB that were retrieved and informed this plan. Used for citation and debugging.
